function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.content:
抱歉，我無法即時查詢最新市場數據。若想知道今日美股或商品（如黃金）的實際交易價，建議您參考以下可靠來源：

| 資料來源 | 網站 / 應用程式 |
|----------|----------------|
| Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets |
| Reuters | https://www.reuters.com/finance/commodities |
| CNBC 金融新聞 | https://www.cnbc.com/world/?region=world |
| Investing.com 商品行情 | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold |

這些平台會提供「當前報價」以及歷史走勢、成交量等資訊。祝你投資順利！
message.reasoning:
The user asks "What is today's gold price?" They want current market data. We cannot provide real-time info; we should respond with an apology or explanation that I can't fetch live data. Possibly suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, etc.

We can also mention typical ranges but not exact numbers. So answer accordingly.
